title: Braised eggplant with garlic and chili paste
methods: Put the aubergine into a bowl of salty water for 5 minutes before drying.
Heat a wok and stir-fry the aubergine until it's completely dry. Add in most of the oil and fry until browning and soft. Remove to a plate.
Lower the heat and fry the garlic and chili bean paste in a little more oil
Add the aubergine back in to the wok with a little water.
Season the aubergine with the oyster sauce, salt and sugar.
When the aubergine is soft and the water has evaporated, add the spring onion and season with white pepper and sesame oil. Serve.
